name: Local mock native BNB
exactTransferEvidence: Native path: Vault credits exactly msg.value and withdrawal checks the exact Vault debit, so no token transfer hook can change the amount (SPEC section 3.1). No issuer exists on a local chain.

issuerReview.mintAuthority: anvil pre-funded accounts; local development chain only

notes: Labeled local mock, never admissible outside chain 31337. The feed is a mock aggregator whose address is assigned when the local deployment runs, so it is null here and recorded in the manifest. A mock aggregator publishes no heartbeat, so maxPriceAge falls back to the 3600-second floor, inside the 60..172800 bounds in Types.sol.
